top_signals.title: 'Desperate Attempt' To Lower Yields: Jonathan Levin
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Opinion's Jonathan Levin joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said today that he’s prepared to expand efforts to buy back costlier debt and that the administration will be unveiling a new fiscal initiative to address the highest borrowing costs in years. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
